title: Automated Retail Demand Forecasting Lifecycle
business: A regional grocery chain managing inventory across hundreds of locations.
problem: Data scientists struggle to reproduce model versions, leading to inconsistent inventory predictions and stock-outs because experiment parameters are tracked manually in spreadsheets.
solution: MLflow provides a centralized platform to log experiment parameters, capture model artifacts, and manage the lifecycle of forecasting models through a unified registry, ensuring full auditability.
steps: Initialize an MLflow experiment to group related forecasting runs.
Log hyperparameters and metrics during model training to ensure reproducibility.
Register the best-performing model version in the Model Registry for staging.
Use MLflow Tracing to monitor the inference pipeline for unexpected data drift.
Promote the validated model to production status within the registry.
outcome: Improved consistency in inventory forecasting and a clear, auditable history of every model version deployed to production.
limitation: The centralized Model Registry can become a bottleneck if access controls are not strictly defined; check for unauthorized model transitions by auditing the registry event logs.
